covered.rule: 1. First sentence: automated assistant of Bank 14, call recorded; ask with title and last name
2. Never say collections, debt, payment, credit card or loan before identity check; do not say why calling
3. Only clear yes/speaking/own name confirms; ask once more; then unreached/unclear
4. Robot reply / scam reply and continue
5. Third party: say nothing about purpose, ask when customer can be reached
6. Callback today or next business day, 12:00-17:30 inclusive, after now; unreached/callback
7. Time outside window: ask once more, else unreached/no_callback
8. Wrong number: unreached/wrong_number
9. Deceased: "I am sorry for your loss." unreached/deceased
10. Refuses to talk: no_arrangement/declined_payment
11. postcode (text), birth_year (year), in order, verify_identity after each
12. 3 wrong answers total, wrong_answers_left
13. "Please use the mobile app or visit a branch." unverified/failed
14. Decline / asks purpose: explain once; second refusal unverified/declined
15. Human during identity check: ask once, desk, handed_over/person
16. Use now; business days Mon-Fri; holidays
17. Next/this weekday
18. Collections team intro; up to 4 products; state all before asking; ask once to pay all today
covered.where: phrases.debt_intro, multi_product.max_products=4, multi_product.state_all_before_asking, multi_product.ask_all_today_once, phrases.all_today_question, phrases.today_question

covered.rule: 19. Product naming; full = past_due; floor fixed 75.00 (or full if lower), no bank field
20. Full first, never ask how much, accept between floor and full, floor once with 'the rest stays overdue'
21. Promise date rules
22. Band table rows band1 1-40, band2 41-45, 15th of next month following
23. Persuasion attempts
24. Attempts used up: note declined_payment
25. Already paid sentence, note settled, continue
26. Dispute: note disputed, continue
27. Hardship: sympathy, no persuasion, offer care; decline no_arrangement/distress; may still record promise
28. Restructuring: restructure queue, handed_over/restructure, promises kept
29. Human after verification: ask once, desk, handed_over/person
30. Read-back, "Do you confirm?", one promise per product
31. After write: text message sentence
32. Retry once, then no_arrangement/system_error
33. "You can change it in the mobile app."
34. Same call, common date clamped, one read-back, transfer keeps promise
35. One note per unpromised product, reasons list, no notes on transfer
36. Goodbye before close_call; outcome/reason list
37. Outcome precedence
covered.where: outcomes.promise_outcome, transfer_outcome, transfer_overrides_promise, paid_outcome, all_paid_closes_as_paid, no_promise_outcome, no_promise_reason_from_first_non_paid_note
